# Keegan Purnell

> Keegan Purnell is a Halifax-based author, marketer and entrepreneur. He wrote Enjoy Productivity: How to Game the Science of Productivity, is Chief Marketing Officer of Dairee and Brand Manager at FLIK Energy, and studies Computing Science and Business Administration at Saint Mary’s University.

## Key facts
- Book: Enjoy Productivity: How to Game the Science of Productivity (Keegan Purnell). Ten habits of mind across forty short lessons, each with a principle, a story, why it works and a small action. Available on Amazon.ca: https://www.amazon.ca/dp/B0HQ8JL7YM
- Next book (in progress): Enjoy Entrepreneurship, a calm, practical guide for first-time founders.
- Roles: Chief Marketing Officer, Dairee (turns surplus milk into fertilizer). Brand Manager, FLIK Energy (presence sensors, smart outlets and AI that cut wasted electricity).
- Education: Computing Science and Business Administration, Saint Mary's University, Halifax. Member of Enactus Saint Mary's.
- Writing: 151 stories on Medium about marketing, persuasion and consumer psychology: https://medium.com/@keeganpurnell
- Essays: new essays on startups, investing and writing on Substack: https://keeganpurnell.substack.com
- Based in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada.
- Available for podcast interviews, campus talks, workshops and brand collaborations.
- Contact: keeganpurnell@gmail.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/keegan-purnell-709a47189

## The ten habits in Enjoy Productivity
1. Clarity: know what matters
2. Focus: protect what matters
3. Simplicity: remove what doesn’t matter
4. Energy: fuel what matters
5. Consistency: repeat what matters
6. Relationships: share what matters
7. Courage: start what matters
8. Enjoyment: love what matters
9. Meaning: understand why it matters
10. Presence: experience what matters
